title: A Learning-Based Superposition Operator for Non-Renewal Arrival Processes in Queueing Networks
summary: The superposition of arrival processes is a fundamental yet analytically intractable operation in queueing networks when inputs are general non-renewal streams. Classical methods either reduce merged flows to renewal surrogates, rely on computationally prohibitive Markovian representations, or focus solely on mean-value performance measures. We propose a scalable data-driven superposition operator that maps low-order moments and autocorrelation descriptors of multiple arrival streams to those of their merged process.
